# R2.4 — env ops + snapshot cadence

Harness: implement-spec (full contract to closeout) — ticket
`docs/tickets/110_R2.4__env-ops-snapshot-cadence.md` (seq 110, Round 2).
Base `svitali/harnessharness-r2.3` @ `709c595`; branch
`svitali/harnessharness-r2.4`; stacked PR; not merged by the worker.
Offline-only honesty ceiling (fixture-verified, never staging/live).

## Scope

- DF-S2.9-3 — the automatic snapshot *producer*: a declared
  `connection_info{snapshot_cadence}` (`on_turn_end` | `on_idle` |
  `every_n_effects:N` | `never` default) takes `fs_tree` (and provider
  `memory` where declared) snapshots at checkpoint/turn boundaries —
  `action.environment.snapshot{taken_by:"cadence"|"suspend"}` durable
  rows without a manual `env snapshot`.
- DF-S2.10-1 — the seven unbacked lifecycle verbs, now boundary-backed
  Group M ops gated on declared driver capabilities: `env.open`,
  `env.attach`, `env.close`, `env.diff`, `env.restore`, `env.upload`,
  `env.download` (BL-13 surface).
- The `suspend{on_idle:"hibernate"}` → memory-snapshot batch + wired
  `restore_in_place` legs verified (S5.8).
- Capability gating is tri-state honest — `Supported`/`Unsupported`/
  `Unknown` stay distinct; a deferred/unavailable verb answers the typed
  refusal, never a fabricated result (R-NOSIDE: no `EnvHandleId` on the
  boundary).

## Design decisions (ratified — ADR-0335)

- **Cadence declaration.** `connection_info{snapshot_cadence}` parses at
  `provision_environment`; spellings `never`/`on_turn_end`/`on_idle`/
  `every_n_effects:N`. A declared cadence on a class with no `Supported`
  snapshot kind refuses `snapshot_cadence_unsatisfiable` at provision
  (fail-closed honesty — a declaration that can never fire is a lie).
- **Cadence seam.** `KernelSink` gains an optional env tail: on
  `lifecycle.turn.finished` (`on_turn_end`) and on each settled
  `action.effect.*` terminal row (`every_n_effects:N`) the sink fires
  `EnvDriver::cadence_take` *before* `lifecycle.run.finished` seals the
  store. `on_idle` fires at the `drive()` park leg (`Port` — the inbox
  emptied mid-turn). Kind selection is capability-led: `memory` when the
  class declares it and the handle is `suspended`, `fs_tree` when
  declared and `ready`; a state-ineligible boundary skips (audited
  `action.environment.failed{op:"snapshot.cadence"}` on an attempted
  take that fails — never silent, never run-fatal).
- **`env.open`/`attach`/`close`** ride `provision`/`attach`/`detach`/
  `teardown`; `env.open` provisions + attaches + mints
  `action.environment.selected` and rebinds the session; `env.close`
  defaults `teardown`, `mode:"detach"` keeps the handle reattachable.
- **`env.diff{baseline}`** — reloads the named `fs_tree` record and
  re-walks the live roots (`hh_helper::fstree::diff`).
- **`env.restore{snapshot_ref, mode?}`** — `successor` (default;
  `fs_tree` only) derives+attaches a successor workspace, mints
  `restored{to_env_handle_id, snapshot_ref, verified}` + `replaced`,
  and rebinds the session; `in_place` is the provider mechanism gated
  on `restore_in_place = supported` (`local_host` answers the typed
  `UnknownCapability` honestly).
- **`env.upload`/`env.download`** — spec direction: upload puts content
  (`content` utf8 or `content_address`) into a writable root; download
  reads a readable path into the blob pool and returns the
  `ContentAddress`. Both mint new audit rows
  `action.environment.uploaded`/`downloaded` (additive class-table
  entries) and refuse `fs` as `UnknownCapability` on provider handles
  (the kernel fs surface does not reach remote envs).
- **`TakenBy` gains `cadence` + `suspend`** spellings; the snapshot row
  gains `taken_by` (+ `quiesced`) members per the §5a.1 record.

## Test matrix (removal-sensitive)

- `crates/hh-env/tests/r2_4.rs` — `cadence_take` legs (fs_tree@ready,

  skips, EveryNEffects counting), `fs_tree_diff`, `restore_successor`
  rows, hibernate `taken_by:"suspend"`, `restore_in_place` verified.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r2_4.rs` — boundary ops end-to-end for
  `local_host`: open/attach/close round-trip + typed refusals;
  upload/download content-addressed round-trip + OutsideRoots/provider
  refusals; diff/restore round-trip; `in_place` honest refusal; cadence
  rows through `submit` (`never`/`on_turn_end`/`every_n_effects`).
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/cap_2_composed.rs` — unignore
  `cap2_fork_at_turn_boundary_without_explicit_snapshot` (declared
  cadence → fork at the boundary snapshot composes).
- `crates/hh-cli/tests/in_process.rs` — the seven verbs dispatch
  through the boundary; the stage_pending catch-all test updated to the
  still-unrouted surface (bogus verb) plus a backed-verb dispatch proof.

## Deviations / notes

- Boundary refusal kinds tightened where the honest answer changed:
  `local_host` suspend/`in_place` legs now answer `UnknownCapability`
  (capability declared-absent) rather than `EnvironmentUnavailable` —
  CAP.2 `cap2_env_suspend_resume_local_host` and conformance
  `s4_13_env_suspend_resume_over_the_boundary` expectations updated.
- The `hh-cli` `stage_pending` catch-all test now exercises a bogus
  verb (`env upload` is backed); a backed-verb dispatch proof added.
- `Roots::is_writable`/`is_readable` canonicalize both operands
  (`canonicalize_path` — deepest-existing-ancestor symlink resolution);
  fixes macOS `/var`→`/private/var` lexical mismatch without weakening
  escape refusal.
- Size: ~1,612 changed lines in tracked files + ~1,575 in the two new
  r2_4 batteries ≈ 3,100 vs the 1,200 budget — the mandated acceptance
  batteries dominate; recorded here per convention.
- Phase 3–6: self-review, gap analysis + ADR, verification, closeout.
